# Phase Two — Twenty Deployment Improvements

1. Name every remote phase before it runs.
2. Trap ERR and print only non-secret diagnostics.
3. Verify production repo directory exists.
4. Verify production repo is a Git repository.
5. Print branch/detached state instead of assuming silently.
6. Retry `git fetch` with bounded attempts and backoff.
7. Verify fetched expected SHA exists as a commit.
8. Verify fetched origin/main equals expected SHA.
9. Reset hard only after SHA validation.
10. Clean only after reset and preserve exact current semantics.
11. Verify post-reset status is clean.
12. Verify HEAD equals expected SHA before activation.
13. Name canonical activation as its own phase.
14. Preserve activation arguments exactly unless its contract proves otherwise.
15. Name homepage verification separately.
16. Name tunnel installer verification separately.
17. Re-verify HEAD after all public checks.
18. Keep deployment script reusable outside GitHub Actions for deterministic diagnosis.
19. Add shell syntax and local preflight tests before push.
20. Do one exact push and verify production with the new reconciliation route canary.
